input.title: Explain your reasoning
input.question: For \(x(t)=t^2\), derive velocity and state its units when x is in metres and t is in seconds.

questions.question: What is \(\frac{d}{dx}x^2\)?
questions.explanation: The power rule gives \(\frac{d}{dx}x^n=nx^{n-1}\), so the derivative is \(2x\).

cards.back: The rate of change of position: \(v=\frac{dx}{dt}\).
The rate of change of velocity: \(a=\frac{dv}{dt}\).
